approach: Add one pure function `undecided_surface_changes(&SurfaceDiff, &[S]) -> Vec<String>` and a private `DECISION_LOG` constant to crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs. It returns one finding line per surface kind with changes, unless the changed paths include docs/decisions.md or the diff is empty. A unit test builds two `SurfaceInventory` values directly, runs the existing `diff`, and checks the flagged and unflagged outcomes. Then fill OLY-A-12 in docs/spec.toml (mechanism names the function, owner Athena, measure ends `status: not shown` and names the test), add an Unreleased/Added bullet to CHANGELOG.md, and append D172 to docs/decisions.md. run/checks.rs is not touched. Nothing is wired into landing, admission or `athena status`. This revision (a) adds the hestia.rs real-spec test to dependents and to the by-name runs, (b) states the real CHANGELOG readers, (c) corrects criterion 1's failing demonstration, and (d) corrects the reason for rejecting the new-heading comparison and states the narrower false negative.

decisions.choice: The check is a pure function over a SurfaceDiff and a list of changed paths; it does not call git.
decisions.reason: `diff` (design_surface.rs:722) already yields added, removed and changed items per kind. `SurfaceInventory` derives Default with public BTreeMap fields (crates/athena-data/src/records/design_surface.rs:12-26), so a test builds inventories without a repository. The caller supplies the paths, so later wiring is one call.

rejected.option: A function taking a Git and two commits that computes the inventories and changed paths itself
rejected.why: It repeats `inventory_at` and `diff` and needs a git fixture per case. The pure form covers the same rule and is smaller.

rejected.option: Wire it into landing or `athena status` now
rejected.why: Out of scope. Wiring adds a refusal and a status label, and no existing status line fits.

decisions.choice: A design decision means the change touches docs/decisions.md (the path rule). Findings are one line per kind with changes, built from `SurfaceDiff::kinds()` (design_surface.rs:635) and `KindDiff::total()` (608). The doc comment and D172 state the limit precisely: the AppendOnly mirror rule means any change to the log is an append, so the false negative is text appended to the log with no new `## D<n>` heading, not 'any edit'. D172 records the follow-up: wiring, and requiring a new heading.
decisions.reason: Criterion 2 and the accepted reading specify the path rule: the log is among the changed paths. It judges structure, not intent, as D162 does for the mirrors. The follow-up is cheap, not large: `athena_data::decision_links::headings(log)` is public (crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs:100) and athena-core already uses that module (run/checks.rs:26). A new entry exists when `headings(candidate).difference(&headings(base))` is non-empty. That would need both log texts as inputs, which changes the signature and the accepted reading, so it is left to the wiring job.

rejected.option: Compare base and candidate logs for a new `## D` heading now, via decision_links::headings
rejected.why: Not because it is large (about two lines) but because it changes the function's inputs from paths to two log texts and departs from the accepted reading and criterion 2. Recorded in D172 as the follow-up.

rejected.option: Parse the new D-entries and require one to name the changed item
rejected.why: That judges intent, which the accepted reading did not ask for.

decisions.choice: The measure is `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`.
decisions.reason: xtask/tests/spec.rs:190-213 requires the measure to end with `status: <label>`, and `measure_problem` in hestia.rs accepts a label starting `not shown` (it is asserted for every active requirement at hestia.rs:4293). The check is not wired into anything `athena status` prints, so no label fits. This is the OLY-A-09 precedent (CHANGELOG.md:12-16).

rejected.why: It needs wiring and a status.rs change, both out of scope.

steps: In crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs, add `const DECISION_LOG: &str = "docs/decisions.md";` (private, with a doc line naming run/checks.rs:7 as its twin) beside the path constants (lines 31-40). Add a module-doc bullet. After `diff` (after line 734) add `pub fn undecided_surface_changes<S: AsRef<str>>(changes: &SurfaceDiff, changed_paths: &[S]) -> Vec<String>`. It returns an empty Vec when `changes.is_empty()` or when any path, after trimming a leading `./`, equals DECISION_LOG. Otherwise it returns one line per entry of `changes.kinds()` with a non-zero `total()`, for example `commands: 1 added, 0 removed, 0 changed, with no entry in docs/decisions.md`. The doc comment says paths are repository-relative with `/` separators, and states the limit: it tests whether the log is among the changed paths, not whether it gained a new `## D<n>` heading.

In the `tests` module of design_surface.rs (line 773), add `a_surface_change_without_a_decision_is_reported_and_one_with_it_is_not`. Build `old` and `new` `SurfaceInventory` values by inserting into the BTreeMaps: a new command, a removed crate, a changed role version. Assert (a) three findings naming commands, roles and crates when the paths are `crates/a/src/lib.rs` only, (b) an empty list when `docs/decisions.md` is added to the paths, (c) an empty list when the paths are `./docs/decisions.md`, (d) an empty list for `diff(&old, &old)` with paths that exclude the log.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`. Temporarily make the function body return `Vec::new()`, confirm assertion (a) fails, then restore the body. Do not edit crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs.

In docs/spec.toml, replace the OLY-A-12 `mechanism = "none"` line with a mechanism naming `undecided_surface_changes` in crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs. Say it returns a finding per surface kind (commands, flags, config keys, record schemas, roles, crates) changed between two inventories when the changed paths exclude docs/decisions.md, and that it is a library check not wired into landing. Keep owner = "Athena". Replace the measure with one ending `status: not shown`, e.g. `Shown by the tests of cargo test -p athena-core design_surface: a surface change without docs/decisions.md among the changed paths is reported, and one with it, or none, is not; status: not shown`.

Append entry `## D172 · ...` after the last line of docs/decisions.md (after a blank line), in the D171 layout (lines 4944-4966): Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance. State the narrower limit: the check tests the path, so text appended to the log with no new `## D<n>` heading silences it. Name the follow-ups: wiring; requiring a new heading through `athena_data::decision_links::headings` (decision_links.rs:100), which is cheap but changes the inputs to two log texts; and de-duplicating the constant with run/checks.rs:7. Provenance says what was read (design_surface.rs, run/checks.rs, decision_links.rs, the OLY-A-09 precedent, the hestia label check) and what was measured (the new test), and that no reading rule changed. Do not use 'supersedes', 'superseded by' or 'amends' in any letter case, do not write the literal headings `## D164 ·` or `## D166`, add no [[link]], and do not edit earlier lines. Grep the new text for the three phrases (case-insensitive) before testing.

Add a bullet at the top of `### Added` under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, in the OLY-A-09 style (lines 12-16), naming `undecided_surface_changes`, the test command, the path-rule limit, and that the measure stays `status: not shown`. It must not contain '3 of the 3 cited jobs', '20261017-173508-0wtc by no check', or the names `reading::check_defined_terms`, `reading::check_history_fixture`, `reading::check_scope_limit`.

Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --locked`, and by name `cargo test -p athena-core --lib the_real_spec_records_every_field`, `cargo test -p xtask --test spec`, `cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest`, `cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors`, `cargo test -p athena-cli decisions`, `cargo test -p athena-core --lib reading` and `cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus`.
